part_category.description: The category of the part, determined by the color of the TOP HEADER BAND of the form. Look at the broad colored strip across the top of the form. If that header band is GREEN, return exactly "Process Scrap Parts". If that header band is ORANGE, return exactly "Supplier Claim Parts". Return exactly one of those two strings.

company.description: Top-left header inside a white box labeled "EBRO", usually reads "EBRO FACTORY". Located at the very top-left of the form.

document_type.description: The large title printed in the colored band near the top, usually "CONTROL CALIDAD". Located below the EBRO logo.

red_number.description: The large red printed number in the white box on the right side of the colored band, e.g. "173432". Located top-right, below the EBRO header.

codigo_conjunto.description: The handwritten value inside the box labeled "CÓDIGO CONJUNTO". Usually a long alphanumeric code starting with numbers, e.g. "40301YS92AAAG4". This label is in the first row of the form body, directly under the green header band.

codigo_componente.description: The handwritten value inside the box labeled "CÓDIGO COMPONENTE". Usually material description, e.g. "Pilar B/Sup/Der". This label is directly bellow codigo_conjunto.

codigo_rechaz.description: The handwritten value inside the small box labeled "CÓDIGO RECHAZ". Usually a short 4 digits alphanumeric code, e.g. "2216". Located on the LEFT side, bellow codigo_componente.

cantidad.description: The handwritten value in the box labeled "CANTIDAD". Usually a single small number, e.g. "2". Located on the RIGHT side, on the same row as cantidad

origen_area_zona.description: The handwritten value in the "ORIGEN" box. Usually a short code like "M1 52". Located on the left side, on the same row as destino

motivo_rechace.description: The rejecting code in the box labeled "MOTIVO RECHACE". Normally 4 digits, may contain letters (e.g. "2216", "2216D"). It is NOT a date and NOT an operator ID. Located in the LOWER HALF of the form, in the second numbered section.

fecha.description: The date when the record is registered, in the box labeled "FECHA". Format "DD/MM/YY" or "DD/MM/YYYY" or "D/M/YY" or "DD/M/YY" , e.g. "22/4/26". Must look like a date.

observaciones.description: The comments describing the issue, in the box labeled "OBSERVACIONES". A short text string, e.g. "Rápido", "Rayado". NOT a number, NOT a date. Located at the BOTTOM-CENTER of the form.

operario.description: The operator ID in the box labeled "OPERARIO". Normally 3 or 4 digits (e.g. "897"). Located directly below "FECHA".

inspector.description: Whether the "INSPECTOR" box has a handwritten signature. Return exactly "Signed" or "Not Signed".

visto_bueno_calidad.description: Whether the "Vº Bº C. CALIDAD" box has a handwritten signature. Return exactly "Signed" or "Not Signed".

encargado_linea.description: Whether the "ENCARGADO LÍNEA" box has a handwritten signature. Return exactly "Signed" or "Not Signed".
